szoveg_eredeti:
EAST PROVIDENCE, R.I. (WPRI) — A new degree program focused on artificial intelligence will soon be offered at the University of Rhode Island.

In this edition of AI Explained, program leaders Indrani Mandal and Dave Kale join us to talk all about it, along with URI professor of marketing Christy Ashley.
